bounds.termination: first slab exit or electron cutoff

cone.stage: source: photons at creation, unit transmission

precision.protocol: #510 time-to-precision T(eps): warm wall time at which every headline observable of a set meets its target RSE, at each arm's own history count, verified on held-out seeds

headline_floor.note: terminal fractions (and transmitted energy, gated on the transmitted fraction) below fraction_mean, and 4pi photon bands below photons_per_primary in the variance pilot, are diagnostics; the cone yield is always headline (rare by design: its cost is what the comparison measures, bounded by the run budget); bands whose lower edge is at or above the beam energy are excluded

block_note: histories per PyRITE block = min(max_block_histories, block_rows / rows_per_history), split into near-equal blocks (pyrite_bench.scene_block/balanced_blocks). rows_per_history is the mean from job 3039. block_rows is the retained-row memory bound (device staging, then host RAM); larger blocks fill more continuation lanes and shorten each block's sparse tail. Before 2026-11-01 blocks were fixed at about 20 M rows (1250 histories at W 1 MeV).
max_steps_note: per-history step limit (exceeding it raises, never truncates or replays); host_pass sizes Ne*max_steps host row buffers, so block*max_steps <= 5e8. Longest pilot-2805 tracks: Si 300 keV 4213, W 300 keV 9874 rows
